title: Can I MASTER Duck Chess?
summary: Five online Duck Chess games vs ~1400-1500 humans; a yellow rubber duck blocker sits on the board.
rules: After making a normal move, the player must move the duck to a different empty square (mandatory every turn).
No piece can move onto or through the duck.
No check or checkmate: kings can be left in check; you win by capturing the king.
Stalemated player (no legal move) wins (chess.com duck rule).
